# AI, Agents & Software Systems

This is the domain map for AI, agents, coding workflows, software systems, model foundations, memory, safety, and verification.

## Why this matters

AI and agents are still a major strength of the vault, but they should no longer dominate the whole second-brain map. This page collects the AI/software material as one strong domain so other life and work domains can stand beside it.

## Current map

| Area | Pages |
| --- | --- |
| Foundations | [AI Foundations & Model Adaptation](/wiki/ai-foundations-and-model-adaptation), [AI Safety & Control](/wiki/ai-safety-and-control) |
| Execution | [Agent Execution Systems](/wiki/agent-execution-systems), [Agentic Engineering](/wiki/agentic-engineering), [Agent Skills](/wiki/agent-skills), [Coding Agent Workflows](/wiki/coding-agent-workflows), [Persistent Agent Threads](/wiki/persistent-agent-threads) |
| Memory and context | [Agent Memory & Context Systems](/wiki/agent-memory-and-context-systems), [LLM Memory](/wiki/llm-memory), [Agent Memory Architectures](/wiki/agent-memory-architectures), [Context Compaction](/wiki/context-compaction), [Memory Transfer Learning](/wiki/memory-transfer-learning), [Open Harnesses](/wiki/open-harnesses) |
| Evaluation and governance | [Agent Evaluation & Verification](/wiki/agent-evaluation-and-verification), [Enterprise Agent Extension Architecture](/wiki/enterprise-agent-extension-architecture), [Proactive Agents](/wiki/proactive-agents), [Trust Boundaries & Assurance](/wiki/trust-boundaries-and-assurance) |
| Organizations and work | [AI-Native Organizations](/wiki/ai-native-organizations), [Skill Partnerships](/wiki/skill-partnerships), [AI Automation Builders](/wiki/ai-automation-builders) |

## Reliability rule

Separate durable systems principles from fast-aging product claims. Product names, model capabilities, release notes, API behavior, prices, and current platform features belong in [Claim Review](/wiki/claim-review) before external reuse.
